visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The camera pans across a light-colored wooden table surface where three orange Louis Vuitton gift boxes are neatly arranged. Each box is tied with a signature blue ribbon and includes a matching orange gift tag. The lighting is bright and even, characteristic of a professional retail or studio environment. (2) A pair of hands with black nail polish and gold rings carefully removes a monogrammed brown canvas wallet from a cream-colored fabric dust bag. The wallet features the iconic LV logo pattern. The hands then open the front flap to reveal a soft pink leather interior and a gold-toned snap button. (3) The demonstration continues as the hands operate a gold zipper on an internal compartment, showcasing the smooth movement and functional design. The setting remains focused on the product interaction atop a dark brown display tray, with soft-focus background elements suggesting an upscale store interior. (4) A second, larger long wallet is extracted from its dust bag, featuring a similar monogram exterior but a deep burgundy red leather interior with multiple card slots and a central zipped pouch. The camera captures the texture of the grain leather and the metallic sheen of the hardware. (5) Finally, a smaller tri-fold compact wallet is presented. The hands unfold it to display the internal brown leather lining and the embossed brand logo. The video concludes with a close-up of the hands holding the item, emphasizing the detail and quality of the luxury goods.
